subject: Close current-head release-readiness blockers: unify version consistency, reconcile desktop capability contract, rerun desktop gates, refresh current-head release evidence, resolve unresolved triage blocker semantics, and align readiness docs.

dimensions.name: feasibility
dimensions.findings: Closure is feasible because the blocker cluster is localized to explicit scripts, config files, and retained evidence artifacts.
dimensions.recommendations: Unify version authority first; then reconcile desktop validator/config policy.

dimensions.name: impact
dimensions.findings: This work directly determines whether the current head can move from NO_GO toward GO.
dimensions.recommendations: Prioritize changes that unlock multiple failing release signals.

dimensions.name: risk
dimensions.findings: Refreshing evidence too early or weakening triage semantics without precision could create false confidence.
dimensions.recommendations: Preserve strictness, but separate genuine blockers from stale/noisy artifact accounting.

dimensions.name: complexity
dimensions.findings: The work spans Python governance scripts, TypeScript package metadata, Tauri capabilities, and desktop packaging.
dimensions.recommendations: Execute in a fixed order to reduce backtracking.

dimensions.name: alignment
dimensions.findings: The requested closure path is fully aligned with the documented release contract and current authority docs.
dimensions.recommendations: Keep the current docs as the target truth; do not create parallel release semantics.

dimensions.name: maintainability
dimensions.findings: Maintainability improves if the repo ends with one authority per concept instead of split policy and implementation.
dimensions.recommendations: Add or retain regression coverage around version authority, desktop contract validation, and triage signal semantics.

decisions.title: Unify release version authority before refreshing evidence
decisions.rationale: Current head has split authority between src-ts 9.2.5 and desktop 9.13.0, which invalidates same-head release proof.

decisions.title: Reconcile desktop capability validator and checked-in capability file
decisions.rationale: Strict sidecar validation is red because policy expects core-only access while the capability file grants additional permissions.

decisions.title: Refresh retained release evidence only after gate failures are fixed
decisions.rationale: Stale retained artifacts are symptoms of the blocker chain, not the first repair target.

decisions.title: Separate true unresolved triage blockers from invalid or legacy state-file noise
decisions.rationale: Current summary reports unresolved triage blockers that were not directly reproducible from parseable active-state files in this checkout.

decisions.title: Broader historical workflow-state cleanup
decisions.rationale: This can follow after the release blocker semantics are made precise.

risk_matrix.description: Evidence refreshed before underlying gates are fixed
risk_matrix.mitigation: Refresh retained proof only after version + desktop gates pass.

risk_matrix.description: Triage blocker semantics are weakened too broadly
risk_matrix.mitigation: Keep unresolved real states blocking; isolate invalid/legacy artifacts separately.

risk_matrix.description: Desktop validator and capability file remain inconsistent
risk_matrix.mitigation: Choose one capability boundary and update validator/docs/config together.
